title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0 Skill Training)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
benefitValue: 100% Free Industry-Aligned Skill Training + Government Skill Certificate + ₹8,000 Direct Assessment Allowance & Job Placement Support
description: Empowers Indian youth with free industry-aligned skill training in Industry 4.0 (AI, Robotics, Drones, Solar) and traditional job roles with placement assistance.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed Indian youth or school/college dropouts aged 15 to 45 years seeking industry skill certification and jobs.
deadline: PMKVY Official Portal (pmkvyofficial.org) / Skill India Digital Hub

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS 2.0 Stipend Support)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
benefitValue: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Stipend Subsidy of 25% (up to ₹1,500/Month) + On-the-Job Industrial Training
description: Promotes on-the-job industrial apprenticeship in top companies, providing monthly stipends directly into bank accounts of youth learning practical trades.
eligibilityDescription: Youth aged 14+ who have completed ITI, Diploma, Degree, or 10th/12th seeking practical apprenticeship training.

title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS Graduate & Diploma Stipend)
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
benefitValue: Government Guaranteed Monthly Stipend of ₹9,000 for Graduate Engineers and ₹8,000 for Diploma Holders for 1 Year
description: Provides 1-year paid practical apprenticeship in top PSUs, government departments, and private industries for fresh engineering, science, and general stream graduates.
eligibilityDescription: Fresh Engineering, Technology, B.Sc, B.Com, B.A, or Diploma pass-outs who graduated within the last 3 years.

title: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP Business Subsidy ₹50 Lakh)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) / KVIC
benefitValue: Capital Loan Margin Money Subsidy up to 35% (Max ₹17.5 Lakh) on Project Loans up to ₹50 Lakh
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme offering financial grant up to 35% to set up micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors, creating mass self-employment.
eligibilityDescription: Any individual above 18 years of age (8th pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing or ₹5 Lakh in service).

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY Rural Job Placement)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Govt. of India
benefitValue: 100% Free Residential Skill Training, Uniform, Boarding & Guaranteed Job Placement with Minimum ₹10,000 Monthly Salary
description: Focuses on rural poor youth, providing demand-driven residential vocational training and guaranteed formal sector job placement with post-placement stipends.
eligibilityDescription: Rural youth aged 15 to 35 years (up to 45 years for SC/ST/Women/PwD) belonging to poor rural households.

title: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman (Artisan Skill & Toolkit Grant)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefitValue: ₹15,000 e-Voucher Toolkit Grant + Collateral-Free Loan up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% Interest + Daily ₹500 Training Stipend
description: Provides holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, mason, tailor, cobbler) including skill training, modern tools, and cheap credit.
eligibilityDescription: Artisans or craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of the 18 traditional trades aged 18+.
deadline: PM Vishwakarma Portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in) / Common Service Centres

title: National Career Service (NCS Free Job Assistance & Career Counseling)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Govt. of India
benefitValue: 100% Free Access to 35+ Lakh Active Job Vacancies, Direct Employer Connections & Free Skill Assessment Tests
description: Nationwide one-stop digital career portal providing job matching, career counseling, online skill courses, job fairs, and placement assistance.
eligibilityDescription: All job seekers, students, fresh graduates, and experienced professionals across India.
deadline: NCS Official Portal (ncs.gov.in) / Model Career Centres

title: DAY-NULM Employment through Skills Training & Placement (EST&P)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefitValue: 100% Free Urban Vocational Skill Training + Guaranteed Job Placement or Micro-Enterprise Credit Support
description: Develops vocational skills among urban poor youth and facilitates wage employment or self-employment micro-enterprises.
eligibilityDescription: Urban poor youth residing in statutory towns and cities belonging to low-income families.
requiredDocs: Urban BPL Certificate / Family Income Proof
deadline: NULM Portal (nulm.gov.in) / City Urban Livelihood Cell

title: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI Entrepreneurship Training)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development & Lead Bank Association
benefitValue: 100% Free Residential Entrepreneurship Training (1 to 6 Weeks) + Free Fooding + Direct Bank Credit Linkage
description: Offers short-term residential skill and business management training to rural youth, followed by 2 years of business handholding and bank loan credit linkage.
eligibilityDescription: Rural youth aged 18 to 45 years interested in starting their own small business, shop, farm, or enterprise.

title: SAMARTH Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector
ministry: Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India
benefitValue: Free Certified Textile & Apparel Skill Training + Monthly Biometric Training Attendance Stipend + Wage Employment Placement
description: Trains and places youth in organized textile, garmenting, spinning, weaving, and technical textile industries across India.
eligibilityDescription: Indian citizens aged 18+ seeking job opportunities in garmenting and textile industry.

title: SANKALP Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness for Livelihood Promotion
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) & World Bank
benefitValue: District Skill Committee Funding, Decentralized Industry Linkages & Micro-Grant for Local Skill Ecosystems
description: Strengthens institutional mechanisms for skill development and increases access to quality skill training for women and marginalized communities.
eligibilityDescription: Youth and district skill development committees seeking localized skill training infrastructure.

title: STRIVE Scheme for ITI Modernization & Industrial Apprenticeship
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
benefitValue: Modern Dual-System Training Equipment in ITIs + Enhanced Industrial Apprenticeship Partnerships
description: Upgrades government ITIs and industry clusters to deliver world-class vocational training matching international standards.
eligibilityDescription: Students enrolled in ITIs or industry apprenticeship programs.

title: Hunar Haat Skill Empowerment & National Market Platform for Artisans
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
benefitValue: 100% Free Stalls at National Crafts Fairs + Daily Travelling & Boarding Allowance + Digital E-Commerce Storefront
description: Provides market exposure, free stall space, and direct sales channels to master craftsmen, traditional artisans, and culinary experts.
eligibilityDescription: Traditional artisans, master craftsmen, and culinary experts from minority and marginalized communities.

title: Seekho Aur Kamao (Learn and Earn Skill Scheme for Minorities)
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
benefitValue: 100% Free Vocational Training + Monthly Attendance Stipend of ₹1,500 + Minimum 75% Guaranteed Job Placement
description: Skill development scheme targeting minority youth to upgrade technical capabilities and secure employment in modern corporate sectors.
eligibilityDescription: Minority community youth (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) aged 14 to 35 with minimum 5th pass qualification.

title: USTTAD Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
benefitValue: Master Craftsmen Apprenticeship Training + Design Innovation Grant + Brand Fair Marketing Support
description: Preserves rich heritage of traditional master crafts, providing skill revival training and global design standardization.
eligibilityDescription: Artisans and young craftsmen practicing traditional Indian arts and handicrafts.

title: Nai Manzil Skill & Formal Education Scheme for School Dropouts
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
benefitValue: Class 8th / 10th NIOS Education Certificate + Certified Vocational Skill + Stipend of ₹4,000 & Job Placement
description: Provides bridge education and certified skill training to school dropouts from minority communities, integrating them into formal job markets.
eligibilityDescription: Minority youth aged 17 to 35 who are school dropouts or educated in madarsas without formal Class 10 certificate.

title: FutureSkills Prime (MeitY - NASSCOM IT Skill Incentive Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) & NASSCOM
benefitValue: Government Skill Cashback Reimbursement up to ₹12,000 upon successfully passing Gold Standard Tech Certification
description: Reimburses course fees to citizens completing emerging technology courses in Cloud Computing, AI, Cybersecurity, IoT, and Big Data.
eligibilityDescription: Indian citizens, IT professionals, and students passing certified FutureSkills Prime assessment exams.

title: Suryamitra Skill Development Program (Solar PV Technician Training)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) & Skill Council for Green Jobs
benefitValue: 100% Free 600-Hour Residential Solar PV Installer Skill Training + Free Boarding & Guaranteed Green Job Placement
description: Trains young ITI/Diploma pass-outs as certified Suryamitra solar technicians to install, operate, and maintain rooftop and utility solar plants.
eligibilityDescription: Youth aged 18+ holding ITI certificate in Electrical/Wireman/Fitter or Diploma in Engineering.
deadline: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) Suryamitra Portal

title: Flexi-Apprenticeship Scheme (Tailored Industry Skill Partnerships)
ministry: Directorate General of Training (DGT) / MSDE
benefitValue: Industry Custom Skill Curriculum + Monthly Industrial Stipend + NCVT Skill Certification
description: Allows industrial conglomerates (TATA, Maruti, L&T) to design custom training courses and hire apprentices directly for factory operations.
eligibilityDescription: Youth seeking custom technical manufacturing and industrial factory training.

title: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS Free ITI Skill Training & Tool Kits)
ministry: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development
benefitValue: 100% Free / Subsidized 1-2 Year Vocational ITI Trade Training + NCVT Certificate + Monthly Stipend
description: Offers vocational trade training across 150+ engineering and non-engineering trades in 15,000+ ITIs across India.
eligibilityDescription: Students passed 8th, 10th, or 12th standard seeking technical trade qualifications.
deadline: State ITI Admission Portals / NCVT MIS Portal

title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Powertrain Technician Skill Certification
ministry: Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) / MSDE
benefitValue: Advanced EV Battery, Motor & Diagnostics Certification + Direct Hiring Placement in EV Manufacturing & Service Outlets
description: Upgrades automotive mechanics and diploma holders with specialized skills in Electric Vehicle battery servicing, BMS, and motor assembly.
eligibilityDescription: Mechanics, ITI auto trade pass-outs, or diploma holders seeking green mobility jobs.

title: Subsidized DGCA Remote Pilot Certification Course for Youth
ministry: Ministry of Civil Aviation & Skill India Digital
benefitValue: Subsidized DGCA Authorized Remote Pilot License Course + High Demand Drone Flying Certification
description: Trains young job seekers to become certified commercial drone pilots for agriculture mapping, infrastructure inspection, and delivery operations.
eligibilityDescription: 10th pass individuals aged 18 to 65 holding a valid Indian Passport or Voter ID.
deadline: DigitalSky DGCA Portal / Skill India Digital

title: General Duty Assistant (GDA) & Paramedic Skill Training Scheme
ministry: Healthcare Sector Skill Council (HSSC) / MSDE
benefitValue: 100% Free Nursing Assistant & Hospital Patient Care Training + Guaranteed Job Placement in Private/Govt Hospitals
description: Prepares male and female youth for high-demand healthcare careers as nursing assistants, home health aides, and emergency medical technicians.
eligibilityDescription: 10th or 12th pass students seeking healthcare sector jobs.

title: Uttar Pradesh Skill Development Mission (UPSDM Free Training Scheme)
ministry: Department of Vocational Education and Skill Development, Govt. of UP
benefitValue: 100% Free Skill Training in 40+ Sectors + Free Uniform & Course Material + Mandatory Job Placement Assistance
description: Aims to train and empower 10 lakh unemployed youth across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh in modern market-driven trades.
eligibilityDescription: Youth of Uttar Pradesh aged 14 to 35 seeking free vocational skill training and employment.

title: UP Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment Loan & Subsidy)
ministry: Department of Infrastructure & Industrial Development, Govt. of UP
benefitValue: Bank Loan up to ₹25 Lakh for Industry and ₹10 Lakh for Service Sector + 25% Government Margin Money Subsidy
description: Provides low-interest loan and 25% capital subsidy to educated unemployed youth in UP to set up small factories, shops, or service businesses.
eligibilityDescription: UP resident youth aged 18 to 40 with minimum 10th pass qualification.

title: Maharashtra Chief Minister Youth Work Training Scheme (CM-YWT Stipend)
ministry: Skill Development, Employment and Innovation Dept, Govt. of Maharashtra
benefitValue: Monthly Internship Stipend of ₹6,000 (12th Pass), ₹8,000 (ITI/Diploma), and ₹10,000 (Graduates) for 6 Months
description: Offers 6-month paid industrial internships to 10 lakh youth in Maharashtra government offices and private corporations to enhance employability.
eligibilityDescription: Youth aged 18 to 35 residing in Maharashtra holding 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, or Degree qualification.

title: Annasaheb Patil Economic Development Corporation Self-Employment Scheme
ministry: Annasaheb Patil Arthik Vikas Mahamandal, Govt. of Maharashtra
benefitValue: 100% Bank Interest Reimbursement on Business Loans up to ₹15 Lakh for 5 Years
description: Reimburses total bank interest incurred on business loans up to ₹15 Lakh to help youth set up commercial transport, retail, or manufacturing ventures.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed youth of Maharashtra aged 18 to 45 years.

title: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Monthly Allowance for Unemployed Graduates)
ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Govt. of Karnataka
benefitValue: Monthly Financial Unemployment Allowance of ₹3,000 for Degree Holders and ₹1,500 for Diploma Holders for 2 Years
description: Provides monthly unemployment financial support for up to 2 years to fresh degree and diploma graduates seeking jobs in Karnataka.
eligibilityDescription: Graduates/Diploma holders who passed in academic year 2022-23 onwards and remained unemployed for 180 days.

title: Tamil Nadu UYEGP Scheme (Unemployed Youth Business Loan & Subsidy)
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
benefitValue: Bank Business Loan up to ₹15 Lakh + 25% Government Capital Subsidy (Max ₹3.75 Lakh)
description: Helps educated unemployed youth in Tamil Nadu establish micro-enterprises in manufacturing, service, and trading businesses.
eligibilityDescription: Tamil Nadu residents aged 18 to 45 (up to 55 for women/SC/ST) with 8th pass qualification and annual family income below ₹5 Lakh.

title: Telangana Telangana Academy for Skill and Knowledge (TASK Skill Program)
ministry: ITE&C Department, Govt. of Telangana
benefitValue: 100% Subsidized Corporate Tech Skills, FinTech & Communication Courses + Campus Placement Drives
description: Connects engineering, degree, and polytechnic students in Telangana with top tech industry skills and campus placement drives.
eligibilityDescription: Students enrolled in colleges across Telangana registered with TASK.

title: Andhra Pradesh APSSDC Free Skill Training & Job Mela Scheme
ministry: Department of Skill Development and Training, Govt. of AP
benefitValue: 100% Free Technical & Vocational Training + Mega Job Mela Hiring Drives in all Districts
description: Empowers AP youth with industry skill hubs, Siemens excellence labs, and weekly district Job Melas.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed youth and students of Andhra Pradesh aged 18 to 35.

title: Utkarsh Bangla Skill Development Scheme (Free Vocational Training WB)
ministry: Department of Technical Education, Training & Skill Development, Govt. of WB
benefitValue: 100% Free Vocational Training (400-1200 Hours) + Free Courseware + Certified Placement Support
description: Offers non-formal vocational training to non-schoolgoers and youth across West Bengal for wage employment.
eligibilityDescription: West Bengal resident youth aged 18 to 35.

title: Gujarat Mukhyamantri Apprentice Yojana (Monthly Stipend Grant)
ministry: Labour and Employment Department, Govt. of Gujarat
benefitValue: Additional Monthly State Government Stipend Allowance of ₹3,000 for Degree and ₹2,000 for Diploma Apprentices
description: Provides additional state monthly stipend over and above central NAPS stipend to encourage industrial apprenticeship in Gujarat factories.
eligibilityDescription: Diploma, Degree, or ITI pass-outs undergoing apprenticeship in Gujarat establishments.

title: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
ministry: Department of Skills, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Govt. of Rajasthan
benefitValue: Monthly Unemployment Financial Allowance of ₹4,500 for Women/Disabled/Transgender and ₹4,000 for Male Youth for 2 Years
description: Provides monthly unemployment allowance to educated unemployed youth in Rajasthan alongside 4-hour daily skill internship.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed Rajasthan resident graduates holding Jan Aadhaar card with annual family income below ₹2 Lakh.

title: Kerala Knowledge Economy Mission (KKEM Knowledge Job Scheme)
ministry: Kerala Development and Innovation Strategic Council (K-DISC), Govt. of Kerala
benefitValue: Free Digital Workplace Skill Upgradation + Global Remote Job & Gig Work Placement Platform (DWMS)
description: Aims to provide 20 lakh educated youth in Kerala with knowledge-based digital jobs, freelance opportunities, and skill certification.
eligibilityDescription: Educated Kerala resident youth and home-based women seeking white-collar digital work.

title: Skilled in Odisha World Skill Center Advanced Technical Training
ministry: Skill Development and Technical Education Dept, Govt. of Odisha
benefitValue: World-Class Advanced Robotics, Precision Engineering & Mechatronics Training at World Skill Center Bhubaneswar
description: Offers premier finishing school skills matching ITE Singapore standards to ITI and Diploma graduates in Odisha.
eligibilityDescription: Odisha resident youth holding ITI or Polytechnic Diploma certificates.

title: Punjab Ghar Ghar Rozgar Mission & Skill Development Scheme
ministry: Department of Employment Generation, Skill Development and Training, Govt. of Punjab
benefitValue: 100% Free Career Counseling, Overseas Employment Bureau Assistance & Job Fair Registrations
description: Provides job search assistance, competitive exam coaching, and legal overseas employment facilitation for Punjab youth.
eligibilityDescription: Job seekers residing in Punjab.

title: Haryana Saksham Yuva Yojana (Skill Training & Monthly Stipend)
ministry: Department of Employment, Govt. of Haryana
benefitValue: Monthly Allowance + Honorary Assignment Stipend up to ₹9,000 for Post-Graduates and ₹7,500 for Graduates (100 Hours Work)
description: Offers 100 hours of monthly honorary work and skill training along with a monthly allowance to unemployed post-graduates and graduates in Haryana.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed Haryana resident post-graduates or graduates registered in Haryana employment exchanges with family income up to ₹3 Lakh.

title: MP Mukhyamantri Seekho-Kamao Yojana (Learn and Earn Monthly Stipend)
ministry: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Dept, Govt. of MP
benefitValue: Monthly Industrial Training Stipend of ₹8,000 (12th Pass), ₹8,500 (ITI), ₹9,000 (Diploma), and ₹10,000 (Graduates) for 1 Year
description: Offers 1-year industrial training in top business establishments in MP with monthly government stipend transferred directly via DBT.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed youth of MP aged 18 to 29 years holding 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, or Degree.

title: Bihar Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayamsahayata Bhatta Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
ministry: Planning and Development Dept / MNSSBY, Govt. of Bihar
benefitValue: Monthly Unemployment Allowance of ₹1,000 for 2 Years (Total ₹24,000) + Mandatory Free Basic Computer & Language Training
description: Provides monthly financial assistance to 12th pass unemployed youth searching for higher education or employment opportunities.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed youth of Bihar aged 20 to 25 who passed 12th and are not enrolled in higher education.

title: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Berozgari Bhatta Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
ministry: Department of Technical Education and Employment, Govt. of Chhattisgarh
benefitValue: Monthly Unemployment Allowance of ₹2,500 for up to 2 Years (Total ₹60,000) + Free Vocational Skill Course
description: Provides financial aid and free skill development training to 12th pass unemployed youth in Chhattisgarh.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed Chhattisgarh residents aged 18 to 35 with 12th pass qualification and annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh.

title: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Rozgar Srijan Yojana (CMRSY Business Subsidy)
ministry: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority & OBC Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand
benefitValue: Self-Employment Loan up to ₹25 Lakh with 40% Capital Subsidy (Max ₹5 Lakh)
description: Provides low-interest credit and 40% capital subsidy to ST/SC/OBC/Minority youth to start businesses or buy commercial passenger/goods vehicles.
eligibilityDescription: Jharkhand resident youth aged 18 to 45 belonging to ST, SC, OBC, Minority, or PwD categories with family income up to ₹5 Lakh.

title: Mukhyamantri Atmanirbhar Asom Scheme (₹2 Lakh Business Grant)
ministry: Department of Industries, Commerce & Public Enterprises, Govt. of Assam
benefitValue: ₹2.0 Lakh Financial Grant (50% Government Subsidy + 50% Interest-Free Loan) for 2 Lakh Youth
description: Empowers 2 lakh unemployed youth in Assam by providing ₹2 Lakh in two installments along with 1-month entrepreneurship training.
eligibilityDescription: Assam permanent residents aged 28 to 40 (28 to 43 for SC/ST/OBC) with 10th pass qualification.

title: Uttarakhand Mukhyamantri Swarojgar Yojana (MSY Business Loan Subsidy)
ministry: Department of Industries, Govt. of Uttarakhand
benefitValue: Project Loan up to ₹25 Lakh (Manufacturing) and ₹10 Lakh (Service) + 15% to 25% Capital Subsidy
description: Promotes self-employment and checks migration in hill districts of Uttarakhand by subsidizing cottage industries, tourism homestays, and shops.
eligibilityDescription: Permanent residents or returned migrants of Uttarakhand aged 18+.

title: Himachal Pradesh Mukhyamantri Swavalamban Yojana (MMSY Business Grant)
ministry: Department of Industries, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh
benefitValue: 30% Capital Subsidy for Men, 35% for Women, and 40% for SC/ST on Project Investment up to ₹1 Crore
description: Encourages local youth in Himachal Pradesh to turn job creators, providing up to 35% capital subsidy on machinery and land investment.
eligibilityDescription: Himachal Bonafide youth aged 18 to 45 years.

title: Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University (DSEU Subsidized Vocation Courses)
ministry: Department of Training and Technical Education, Govt. of NCT of Delhi
benefitValue: 100% Fee Waiver Scholarships for Low-Income Students + World-Class Applied Skill Degree & Diploma Courses
description: Operates 20+ specialized skill campuses in Delhi offering practice-led diploma and degree programs with guaranteed industry internships.
eligibilityDescription: Students residing in Delhi passing 10th or 12th seeking skill education.

title: J&K Mission Youth MUMKIN Scheme (Subsidized Commercial Vehicle Grant)
ministry: Mission Youth, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir
benefitValue: Up to ₹80,000 Government Subsidy + Matching Vehicle Manufacturer Discount on Small Commercial Vehicles
description: Enables unemployed youth in Jammu & Kashmir to buy small commercial goods vehicles (Tata Ace, Mahindra Bolero PikUp) with zero down payment for sustainable livelihoods.
eligibilityDescription: Unemployed J&K domicile youth aged 18 to 35 holding valid commercial driving license.
